title: Compass Craft Academy Story Theme Card

endingEchoPrompt: ending echo: write how the ending repeats the compass clue in a calmer or clearer way: ____________________.

quietOptionLine: Quiet option: fill only the story question, character choice, and theme line blanks first: ____________________.
takeHomeLine: Take-home line: save this paper theme card and add one new compass clue later: ____________________.
